neighbours.label: non-initial subword piece of a donor's name in a named foundation or endowed institution (Luc|ile Packard, Ke|ck, Mel|inda Gates, Ann|enberg)
fire: This work was supported by the David and Lucile Packard Foundation and by a university fellowship.
Funding for the telescope came from the W. M. Keck Foundation and private donors.
The clinic was opened with a grant from the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation in 2012.
She studied journalism at the Annenberg School for Communication in Philadelphia.
The program is a partnership with the William and Flora Hewlett Foundation.
He now teaches surgery at the Keck School of Medicine of USC.
Additional support was provided by the Kavli Foundation and the Simons Foundation.
The authors thank the Lucile Packard Children's Hospital for access to its records.
quiet: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation and by a university fellowship.

notes: Card peaks: Luc|ile, ' and' in 'Ann and John H.', P|ritz|ker, Ke|ck, 'inda', 'enberg'. Probe: Lucile Packard 0.98, Keck School 0.80, Keck Foundation 0.73, Melinda Gates Foundation 0.66, MacArthur ' and' 0.51, Melinda outside a foundation 0.39, Lurie 0.28, single-token 'Ford Foundation' 0.17, 'bread and cheese' 0.01.
